While network architecture WRN-28-20 requires roughly three-four times more computation than WRN-28-10, the aggressive learning rate reduction of SGDR nevertheless allowed us to achieve a better error rate in the same time on WRN-28-20 as we spent on 200 epochs of training on WRN-28-10.

Specifically, Figure (right middle and right bottom) show that after only 50 epochs, SGDR (even without restarts, using ) achieved an error rate below 19% (whereas none of the other learning methods performed better than 19.5% on WRN-28-10).
When 30 epochs were considered, we dropped the learning rate by a factor of 10 at epoch indexes 10, 15 and 20.

Clearly, longer runs (more than 40 epochs considered in this preliminary experiment) and hyperparameter tuning of learning rates, regularization and other hyperparameters shall further improve the results.
